column2: I give everything I harvested to bring light back to that false sky and let everyone keep dreaming a little longer. My shift is over: put me back on the grass, beside the one waiting for me, before the cold puts us out too.

I cannot believe the energy I harvested and burned as fuel is the minds of those who came before us. I will not sacrifice them just to keep someone else's false paradise alive a little longer. I am sorry, but I will not feed this battery: I am opening the hull so we can all go back together, toward a new beginning.
The home battery is at zero. The channel is silent, the servers grow cold in the dark, and the last dream goes out before you can return.
